name: Hungary
visaRequirements: Schengen Visa required for most non-EU citizens
currency: Hungarian Forint (HUF) — Hungary is in the EU but not the Eurozone
bestExperience: Best experience: the Flipper pinball museum — the best hours I've ever spent on retro games, and nowhere near anyone's Budapest shortlist.

about.description: Hungary, for most visitors, means Budapest — two cities either side of the Danube that merged into one. Hilly Buda holds the castle and the Fisherman's Bastion; flat Pest holds the parliament, the ruin bars and most of the thermal baths. It is one of the cheaper capitals in Europe and one of the best value.
highlights: The Hungarian Parliament Building from across the Danube
Széchenyi and the other thermal baths
Fisherman's Bastion and the Buda castle district
An evening Danube cruise once the buildings are lit
St. Stephen's Basilica and the State Opera House

travelTips.bestTimeToVisit: April to June and September to October; the baths are at their best in winter
transportation: Budapest's metro, tram and bus network covers everything
Tram 2 along the Pest embankment is a sightseeing route in its own right
No car needed for a city break
culturalNotes: Hungary uses the forint, not the euro — avoid airport exchange rates
Card is accepted widely, but keep some cash for markets
Tipping around 10% is normal in restaurants
